entities.name: The Emperor of Mankind
entities.description: Ruler of the Imperium, called the greatest psyker in Human history, who has sat immobile in a continent-spanning palace for thousands of years.

entities.name: Space Marines
entities.description: The Emperor's warriors, called his bulwark against the Terror.

entities.name: Orders Militant
entities.description: Sisters who took up the cry of faith against Chaos.

entities.name: Chaos
entities.description: The forces and powers of the Warp that seek to corrupt and destroy the Imperium.

entities.name: Imperium
entities.description: Humanity's realm, in which countless xenos cults lurk unseen.

entities.name: Canticle of Absolution
entities.description: A canticle quoted by the Grey Knights.

entities.name: Thunderwolves
entities.description: Great wolves whose tracking and training is an initiation into the Wolf Guard.

entities.name: Wolf Guard
entities.description: An elite whose upper echelons are entered by training Thunderwolves.

entities.name: Adeptus Custodes
entities.description: The bodyguards of the Emperor of Mankind, whose Praetors are an unmatched bulwark.

entities.name: Genestealer Cults
entities.description: Cults that bide their time on Imperial worlds, spreading corruption and awaiting the Tyranids.

entities.name: Lords of Change
entities.description: Tzeentch's greatest servants, the most powerful of whom wield fragments of his power over destiny.

entities.name: Tzeentch
entities.description: A Chaos god of change and scheming who sends visions of possible futures to his acolytes.

entities.name: Anrakyr the Traveller
entities.description: A Necron who awoke from his slumber seeking to reunite the myriad dynasties.

entities.name: Death Guard
entities.description: Followers of Nurgle who are immune to blight grenades.

entities.name: Adeptus Mechanicus
entities.description: The Imperial order of tech-magi.

entities.name: Necrons
entities.description: An ancient race of living-metal beings bound to dynasties, awakening from the Great Sleep to reclaim the galaxy.

entities.name: Illuminor Szeras
entities.description: A Necron who speaks of immortality and of the C'tan Aza'gorod.

entities.name: Vargard Obyron
entities.description: A Necron of the Sautekh Dynasty who speaks of unfailing loyalty.

entities.name: Sautekh Dynasty
entities.description: A Necron dynasty.

entities.name: Abaddon the Despoiler
entities.description: A Chaos leader who vows to bring down the false Emperor; under his rule Chaos shall reign.

entities.name: Nurgle
entities.description: A Chaos god of plague and pestilence.

entities.name: Kulvain Hestarius
entities.description: A warrior of the Death Guard who became Death through Nurgle's favour.

entities.name: Nurgle's Rot
entities.description: A plague whose victims' blighted souls become plaguebearers.

entities.name: Plaguebearers
entities.description: Daemons of Nurgle's realm formed from souls slain by Nurgle's Rot.

entities.name: Rot Flies
entities.description: Colossal daemonic insects ridden by high-ranking plaguebearers.

entities.name: Walking Pox
entities.description: A virulence that rots the infected to death while keeping them conscious, creating Poxwalkers.

entities.name: Red Thirst
entities.description: A dark path that Sanguinary Priests warn their brothers to deny.

entities.name: Zander At'lan
entities.description: A commander of the Tallarn 115th Armoured Regiment.

entities.name: Tallarn 115th Armoured Regiment
entities.description: An Imperial armoured regiment.

entities.name: Aza'gorod
entities.description: A C'tan described as the embodiment of death and killer of stars and worlds.

entities.name: Inquisitor Greyfax
entities.description: An Inquisitor who condemns witchcraft and technology alike as blasphemous.

entities.name: Szarekh
entities.description: The Silent King of the Necrons, who learned the true nature of the C'tan and now awakens to reclaim the galaxy.

entities.name: C'tan
entities.description: Beings who once sought to rule the Necrons and now serve them, their shards powering Necron machines.

entities.name: The Book of Mournful Night
entities.description: An in-world writing about the Silent King and the C'tan.

entities.name: Trazyn the Infinite
aliases: The Archaeovist of the Solemnace Galleries
entities.description: A Necron collector who seeks every treasure in the galaxy and claims an empire of knowledge.

entities.name: Solemnace Galleries
entities.description: Trazyn's collection.

entities.name: Lord Traedrekkh
entities.description: A lord of the Sekemtar Dynasty.

entities.name: Sekemtar Dynasty
entities.description: A Necron dynasty.

entities.name: Brazen Thunder
entities.description: Foremost of the bloodcrusher legions, named for the sound they make riding into battle.

entities.name: Sha'ris
entities.description: A Herald of Slaanesh offering indulgence without regret.

entities.name: Galaxos Klynesmith
entities.description: A biophagus.

entities.name: Tyranids
entities.description: Alien swarms advancing across the galaxy in living Hive Ships to consume all.

entities.name: Day of Ascension
entities.description: The day Genestealer Cultists believe their star-born gods descend.

entities.name: Blood Angels
entities.description: A Space Marine force who fought the Tyranids at Phodia and in the Battle of Baal.

entities.name: Phodia
entities.description: A city transformed by Tyranid invasion.

entities.name: Skull Throne
entities.description: The throne for which skulls are taken in Khorne's name.

entities.name: Kalos the Ravager
entities.description: A warrior of Chaos who begs not to be placed in a Helbrute sarcophagus.

entities.name: Khorne
entities.description: A Chaos god whose sole desire is to drown the galaxy in slaughter.

entities.name: Exterminatus Extremis
entities.description: An in-world writing justifying planetary destruction.

entities.name: The Hospitaller's Book of Hours
entities.description: An in-world writing of the Sisters Hospitaller.

entities.name: Oath of the Penitent
entities.description: An oath of the Sisters Repentia.

entities.name: Captain Ascote
entities.description: An officer who warns about a Venomthrope's cloud.

entities.name: Hive Mind
entities.description: The psychic power that dominates the Tyranid hive fleets.

entities.name: Commissar Yarrick
entities.description: An Imperial commissar.

entities.name: Canoness Lucretia
entities.description: A Canoness who ended a battle standing atop a pile of Tyranid corpses.

entities.name: Battle of Baal
entities.description: The bloodiest and most costly battle in the history of the Sons of Sanguinius.

entities.name: Lord Commissar Barron Reed
entities.description: An Imperial Lord Commissar.

entities.name: Viridia IV
entities.description: An Agri-World whose motto calls for defeating hunger in the Emperor's name.

entities.name: Mortarion
entities.description: A Daemon Primarch who preaches festering bitterness.

entities.name: Ku'gath Plaguefather
entities.description: A follower of Nurgle who praises the plague's progress.

entities.name: Dremark Eigen
entities.description: A sergeant whose last words called for Agresto.

entities.name: Agresto
entities.description: A soldier under Sergeant Dremark Eigen who fails to answer.

entities.name: Uriel Ventris
entities.description: A captain who hit the xenos with everything to no avail.

entities.name: Lieutenant Krakos
entities.description: An officer who addressed his troops before the Bloodmoon Massacres.

entities.name: Bloodmoon Massacres
entities.description: Massacres apparently linked to the Necrons.

entities.name: Eye of Terror
entities.description: A region where Chaos Marines plot and the Traitor Legions were driven; site of the Planet of Sorcerers.

entities.name: Kairos Fateweaver
entities.description: A servant of Tzeentch who speaks of change and time.

entities.name: Cyrus Jalili
entities.description: A platoon commander of the Prandium Defence Auxilia who doubted the beasts could bomb from orbit.

entities.name: Prandium Defence Auxilia
entities.description: A defence force.

aliases: Supreme Grand Master of the Grey Knights
entities.description: The Supreme Grand Master of the Grey Knights.

entities.name: Grey Knights
entities.description: An order led by Kaldor Draigo.

entities.name: Tor-213
entities.description: A Fusilave unit that reports a target eradicated.

entities.name: Triarch
entities.description: Whose mark all Necrons bear, binding them to their dynasty.

entities.name: Warp
entities.description: A source of baleful energies that can fuel powerful rituals.

entities.name: Magnus the Red
entities.description: A sorcerer whose staff sphere transforms enemies into chaos spawn; his redoubt is the Tower of the Cyclops.

entities.name: Necrontyr
entities.description: The fleshly ancestors of the Necrons, who lost almost all individuality in biotransference.

entities.name: Biotransference
entities.description: The process that imprisoned the Necrontyr in living metal forms.

entities.name: Necrodermis
entities.description: The endlessly adaptive living metal from which all Necrons are made.

entities.name: Magus Lucea Kane
entities.description: A Genestealer Cult magus who hails the Children of the Stars.

entities.description: One who once besieged the Sol System.

entities.name: Sol System
entities.description: The Emperor's star system, once besieged by Horus.

entities.name: Lectitio Divinitatus
entities.description: An in-world writing praising Sol as of the Emperor.

entities.name: The Book of Tzeentch
entities.description: An in-world writing voicing Tzeentch.

entities.name: Colonel Pannet
entities.description: An officer who praises the Catachan warrior.

entities.name: Catachan
entities.description: Warriors praised as swift, sharp and stubborn.

entities.name: The Saga of Khorne
entities.description: An in-world writing praising Khorne.

entities.name: Lord Marshal Toshenko
entities.description: A Lord Marshal who exhorted the Vostroyan 16th.

entities.name: Vostroyan 16th
entities.description: An Imperial regiment.

entities.description: A member of the Cult of the Sacred Union preaching indulgence.

entities.description: A cult.

entities.name: Great Sleep
entities.description: The long slumber of the Necrons.

entities.description: A commissar who dismissed a Necron ruin as harmless.

entities.description: A world in the Eye of Terror.

entities.name: Tower of the Cyclops
entities.description: The redoubt of Magnus the Red.

entities.name: Marneus Calgar
entities.description: An Imperial commander who notes Old One Eye is on the hunt.

entities.name: Hive Pandorial
entities.description: A hive where a squad found only shambling corpses.

entities.name: Hall of Heroes
entities.description: Catacombs where a Chapter's honored dead are interred and fossilized.

entities.description: A planet of endless fighting that has become an Ork pilgrimage site.

entities.name: Orks
entities.description: A warlike race that treats Armageddon as holy.

entities.name: Magos Varnak
entities.description: A Magos lamenting the ceaseless hunger.

entities.description: A Tyranid on the hunt.

entities.description: A constantly shifting labyrinth mirroring Tzeentch's scheming.

entities.name: Forbidden Cities
entities.description: Abandoned tunnels and bunkers below the hive city, secretly recolonized.

entities.description: Hailed by Magus Lucea Kane.

entities.description: Forces driven into the Eye of Terror.

entities.description: A sergeant who orders a Tyranid source torched.

events.summary: Missionaries, pilgrims and sisters of the Orders Militant take up the cry, and the forces of Chaos melt before their faith.
events.quote: The forces of Chaos melted before the fire of their faith.

events.summary: In the past, the Silent King realizes the true nature of the C'tan and the doom wrought in his name.
events.quote: When the Silent King saw what had been done, he knew at last the true nature of the C'tan

events.summary: The Necrontyr lose almost all individuality in biotransference, imprisoned in living metal.
events.quote: During biotransference, the Necrontyr lost almost all individuality.

events.summary: Horus once besieged the Sol System, as Abaddon recalls.
events.quote: As Horus once besieged the Sol System, we shall bring the rotting Imperium to its knees.

events.summary: Anrakyr the Traveller awakens from slumber seeking to rebuild a united Necron galaxy.
events.quote: Anrakyr the Traveller awoke from his slumber with a singular goal: to rebuild a united Necron galaxy.

events.summary: The Blood Angels arrive at Phodia to find it transformed by the Tyranid hive fleet.
events.quote: By the time the Blood Angels descended from the heavens, Phodia was a city transformed.

events.summary: Kalos the Ravager begs to be killed rather than be placed in a Helbrute sarcophagus.
events.quote: "No. No! Not the sarcophagus . . . Khorne damn you, you disloyal curs. JUST KILL ME!"

events.summary: Canoness Lucretia ends a battle against a Tyranid wave atop a pile of charred alien corpses.
events.quote: ended with Canoness Lucretia standing atop a huge pile of charred alien corpses.

events.summary: The Battle of Baal is the bloodiest in the history of the Sons of Sanguinius.
events.quote: The Battle of Baal was the bloodiest and most costly in the entire noble history of the Sons of Sanguinius.

events.summary: Sergeant Dremark Eigen speaks his last words calling for Agresto.
events.quote: "Agresto, bring up the rear . . . Agresto?" —Sergeant Dremark Eigen, last words

events.summary: Lieutenant Krakos addresses his troops before the Bloodmoon Massacres.
events.quote: Address by Lieutenant Krakos prior to the Bloodmoon Massacres

events.summary: Tech-Priest Darvin is executed for heresy after praising Necron elegance.
The Great Rift opens and many Imperial worlds are lost to Chaos.
events.quote: When the Great Rift opened across the Galaxy, many Imperial worlds were lost to Chaos.

events.summary: The disillusioned people of Chancer's Vale turn from the Imperium to other powers.
events.quote: Disillusioned with the Imperium, the population of Chancer's Vale turned to other, hungrier powers for meaning.
